title: Positive variance of a nonconstant product function
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function that assigns positive mass to every element of $\Omega$, and let $n$ be a natural number. Every nonconstant function $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb{R}$ has strictly positive variance under the product distribution with marginal law $\pi$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ assigns nonzero mass to every element of $\Omega$
